Leak Suggests Bend Studio Is Developing a New Co‑Op PlayStation Game for 2027

03 Nov 2026, 12:27 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: gamerant.com

2 min read

Key takeaways--- The information above combines publicly known facts with claims from an unnamed source. Until Sony or Bend Studio confirms the project, details should be treated as provisional.

In this article
  1. What the leak reveals
  2. Confirmed background
  3. Reported but unverified details

What the leak reveals

  • An anonymous Bend Studio employee told MP1st that the studio is working on a third‑person co‑op game slated for announcement and launch in 2027.
  • The source said the project is not a live‑service title and that its development stage is farther along than the public might expect.
  • No official name or IP has been confirmed; the game does not appear to be set in the Days Gone universe.

Confirmed background

  • Bend Studio last released a new title in 2019 – the open‑world zombie game Days Gone – which sold over 7 million copies despite mixed reviews.
  • The studio’s earlier work includes the critically‑acclaimed Syphon Filter series, released across PS1, PS2 and PSP.
  • The most recent official activity from Bend was the Days Gone Remastered patch (October 2025) and the Broken Road DLC (April 2025).

Reported but unverified details

  • The leak mentions a cancelled 2025 project codenamed “Mirror Pond,” described as a live‑service game.
  • The new title could be a brand‑new IP or an adaptation; the source gave no clarification.
  • Director Jeff Ross has publicly stated that Days Gone will not receive a sequel, which aligns with the hint that the upcoming game is unrelated to that franchise.

What remains unknown

  • Exact gameplay mechanics, story setting, and whether the game will support cross‑play are not disclosed.
  • Pricing, platform exclusivity beyond PlayStation, and the size of the co‑op roster are still speculative.

Practical implications for gamers

  • If the leak is accurate, PlayStation owners can expect a fresh co‑op experience from a studio that has not released a new IP in eight years.
  • The 2027 launch window places the game alongside other high‑profile PS5 releases such as Until Dawn 2 (January 28) and God of War: Laufey (February 16).

How to verify the claim

  1. Monitor official Sony and Bend Studio channels for any press releases or trailer drops in the coming months.
  2. Watch major gaming events (e.g., PlayStation Showcase, E3, Gamescom) where Sony often announces upcoming titles.
  3. Look for trademark filings or developer credits in public databases that reference new Bend Studio projects.

--- *The information above combines publicly known facts with claims from an unnamed source. Until Sony or Bend Studio confirms the project, details should be treated as provisional.*
